run_phonemize_with_sil: run the phonemize_with_sil script to convert words to phones using a lexicon file with optional silence insertion
run_phonemize_with_silence_probability: run the phonemize_with_sil script with --sil-prob to randomly insert silence tokens between words based on probability
run_phonemize_with_surround: run the phonemize_with_sil script with --surround to add silence tokens at the start and end of each line
review_get_parser: review the get_parser function that builds an argparse parser with --sil-prob, --surround, and --lexicon arguments
review_main: review the main function that loads a lexicon, reads words from stdin, and converts them to phones with optional silence
